_description: Tool Gateway configuration used when database_enabled=false in llmConfig.ini. For streamable-http services (vertexai, backstage), tools are discovered live from the MCP endpoint and the tools array here is ignored. For api-transport services (quasar), list every tool the agent may call.

Quasar._description: QPP / MyWizard Quasar REST API (transport=api). Credentials are read from llmConfig.ini [Quasar] or the secret store. Each tool's auth token is injected as the 'apiToken' request header.

Tool_definition.description: Using the OpenAISearchVectorGenerate API, filter documents for a subset of useful information and transform the extracted information into another format. For example, based on a list of incidents with an ID and a Description, generate a set of testcases. Supports advanced metadata and similarity filtering.

query.description: Plain text which needs to be looked at the Open AI document for explanation.

config.description: Specify the source of where to target the search. If not set, generic OpenAI information will be used.

max_count.description: The maximum number of items/records to be generated e.g. 100 use cases.

chunk_size.description: The number of calls in each LLM batch call.

outpul_eval.description: Desired response format for output data; use * to indicate no specific format is required.

prompt_prefix.description: How Quasar++ should approach the task.

prompt_suffix.description: Additional information explaining how information could be extracted or inferred.

prompt_template.description: The structure or format of the ingested data inputs.

prompt_objective.description: High-level goal that focusses the search.

Tool_definition.instructions: Use @metadata: to filter by metadata tags. Use @similarity: for semantic similarity search. Use @content: to get content from specific fields. Use @file_name: to filter by filename. Note: file_name and metadata cannot be used together in the same request.

Tool_definition.description: Search for related information from a vector database using vector similarity. Returns vectors with the highest similarity scores to the query. Supports @metadata:, @similarity:, @content:, @file_name: filter prefixes.

index.description: Index name to search. Deterministically defaulted when the caller/agent does not supply one; a generated agent injects its own dedicated index via tool_arg_overrides.

query.description: Plain text query. Supports @metadata:, @similarity:, @content:, @file_name: filter prefixes.

output.description: Desired response format; use * for no specific format.

search_limit.description: Maximum number of vector results to return.

search_criteria.description: Retrieval strategy for the vector search. 'knn' = vector nearest-neighbour similarity, 'keyword' = lexical match, 'graph' = knowledge-graph traversal. May be combined; defaults to knn+keyword+graph when not specified.

Tool_definition.instructions: Use @metadata: to filter by metadata tags. Use @similarity: for semantic similarity search. Use @content: to get content from specific fields. Use @file_name: to filter by filename. Note: file_name and metadata cannot be used together in the same request.

Tool_definition.description: Ask QPP's own LLM a question against an indexed corpus. Returns a refined natural-language answer in 'content' field that can be used as the similarity query in a subsequent QuasarSearchVector call. Use this as Stage 1 of the two-stage RAG flow (ChatCompletion → SearchVector).

prompt.description: Natural-language question or passage to reason over.

index.description: Index to search when generating the response. A generated agent injects its own dedicated index via tool_arg_overrides.

reset_context.description: Reset conversation context on each call for stateless retrieval.

search_criteria.description: Retrieval strategy used internally by QPP when generating the response. 'knn' = vector nearest-neighbour, 'keyword' = lexical, 'graph' = knowledge-graph. May be combined.

Tool_definition.instructions: Stage 1 of the two-stage RAG flow. Call with the user query as 'prompt'; extract 'content' from the response and use it as the 'query' for a subsequent QuasarSearchVector call.

Tool_definition.description: Upload a document file to a specified Quasar index for ingestion and vectorisation.

file.description: Document file to upload. Pass via the files parameter of invoke_tool_gateway().

index.description: Index name where the document will be stored.

Tool_definition.description: List the documents that have been indexed under a given Quasar index. Returns an array of {doc_name, ...}.

index.description: Index name whose documents should be listed. Supplied via tool_arg_overrides by a generated agent.

Tool_definition.instructions: Index is passed as a path segment. Use to confirm a document is present in an index before/after upload.

Tool_definition.description: Check the status of an asynchronous document upload by its TaskID. Returns the formatted status (Completed, Started, etc.).

task_id.description: TaskID returned by the upload call. Supplied via tool_arg_overrides.

Tool_definition.instructions: TaskID is passed as a path segment. Poll until Status is Completed before running vector/graph steps against a freshly uploaded document.

Tool_definition.description: List knowledge-graph workspaces for an index. Used to detect whether a SAVED graph already exists (enabling graph search criteria).

index_name.description: Index whose graph workspaces should be listed. Supplied via tool_arg_overrides.

Tool_definition.instructions: Returns {workspaces: [{workspace_id, status, node_count, ...}]}. A workspace with status SAVED means graph search is available.

Tool_definition.description: Create a knowledge-graph workspace for an index (step 1 of the create-graph flow).

workspace_name.description: Workspace name. Supplied via tool_arg_overrides (e.g. adlc_ws_<index>).

index_name.description: Index the workspace is built over.

Tool_definition.instructions: Returns {workspace_id}. Follow with QuasarKGBuild, then poll QuasarKGWorkspaceList until STAGED/SAVED, then QuasarKGSave.

Tool_definition.description: Trigger asynchronous entity extraction (graph build) for a workspace (step 2 of the create-graph flow).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to build. Supplied via tool_arg_overrides.

index_name.description: Index the workspace is built over.

Tool_definition.instructions: Returns {task_id}. Build is async; poll QuasarKGWorkspaceList until status is STAGED/SAVED.

Tool_definition.description: Fetch the staged (built but not yet committed) knowledge-graph entities for a build task.

task_id.description: Build task_id from QuasarKGBuild. Supplied via tool_arg_overrides.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose staged graph is reviewed.

Tool_definition.instructions: Returns {nodes, summary}. Zero nodes with zero token_usage means extraction produced nothing; skip save and fall back to knn+keyword.

Tool_definition.description: Commit a staged knowledge graph (STAGED -> SAVED) so graph search becomes available for the index (final step of the create-graph flow).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to save. Supplied via tool_arg_overrides.

Tool_definition.instructions: Returns {entities, structural_nodes}. Zero of both means nothing was extracted; graph search stays disabled.

Quasar.config: {"description": "Quasar service for vector search, document search-and-generate, and document upload over indexed knowledge bases"}

config.description: Vertex RAG service for semantic search over enterprise knowledge corpus via MCP
